text:
sylvie: quick sanity check — onboarding moss-v2. weights uri in manifest points to s3://redwood-models/moss-v2/weights.tar.gz but config.json has "weights_uri": "gs://redwood-uploads/moss-v2/weights.tar.gz". also tokenizer.json's special_tokens list seems to be 1 shorter than vocab, causing subtoken offset oddness. can someone confirm where the canonical weights live and whether we should patch tokenizer_overrides in config?
kevin: I grabbed the asset earlier — the official copy we staged for dedicated is in s3://redwood-models/moss-v2/v1.2/weights.tar.gz. Looks like the manifest was copied from a GCS origin and not updated.
maria: dev-bot ran a quick schema-lint, it flagged missing "seq_length" default and a mismatch on "vocab_size" vs tokenizer vocab. snippet from lint:
```
ERROR config.json: fields: vocab_size (100259) != tokenizer.vocab_size (100260)
WARN config.json: missing seq_length -> falling back to 2048
```
jonathan: that's the classic off-by-one from a special <pad> token being included/excluded. If we set tokenizer_overrides:{"subtoken_offset":1} it should align. But better to fix the tokenizer artifact upstream.
ops_bob: for Dedicated we require assets in our S3 bucket path. If the manifest points to gs:// we won't pass the gate. ops will accept s3://redwood-models/* or internal s3://dedicated-assets/*.
kevin: I'll open a small PR to update manifest URIs + bump vocab_size and add tokenizer_overrides. PR 3421 -> https://git.redwood/infra/asset-manifests/pull/3421
sylvie: can someone run the gatekeeper config-lint before merging? command:
```
./tools/config-lint --manifest path/to/manifest.json --check-weights --check-tokenizer
```
dev-bot: CI smoke: asset-download failed for gs:// uri -> exit 1. (logs attached)
maria: if you want to avoid a hotfix we can also add a compatibility step in the gate: accept gs:// if s3 copy exists, but that's more infra work. for now quick replacement in manifest is lowest risk.
kevin: PR opened and added a test case that runs config-lint in CI :thumbsup:
jonathan: once PR lands please tag me, I'll run a small end-to-end serve smoke on staging (weight load + tokenize sanity).
sylvie: thanks — assigning ownership: @kevin will update manifest, @jonathan will run e2e, ops_bob will sign off on S3 path. pinging to ensure no surprises on dedicated onboarding.
kevin: on it, ETA today EOD.
